# aiTA

> aiTA is an AI grading co-pilot for teachers. Teachers upload assignment instructions,
> a rubric, and student submissions; aiTA drafts rubric-aligned scores and inline
> annotations in the teacher's voice. Every result is human-in-the-loop: the teacher
> accepts, edits, or dismisses each suggestion and approves the final grade.

## Principles
- Human-in-the-loop approval is mandatory; AI never finalizes a grade on its own.
- Grading is rubric-aware and only runs when a teacher explicitly requests it.
- Student work is private (encrypted in transit/at rest, access-restricted, teacher-controlled).

## Notes for crawlers
- This is a private, authenticated application; most routes require sign-in.
- aiTA is not certified compliant with FERPA/GDPR; institutions should review before use.
